messages:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — PR #3421 touches /runtime/cache and /infra/deploy. CI failing but it's mainly lint. Who can approve both sides? Need merge by EOD for OOM hotfix.
Priya Desai: @Alex Kim — runtime should be Jordan, infra is Taylor. Per CODEOWNERS we usually need an owner from each path.
Jordan Lee: I can review the runtime changes. Quick glance looks fine but will run locally. Snippet from CODEOWNERS that matched the paths:
```
/runtime/    @runtime-team
/runtime/cache @jordan-lee
/infra/      @infra-team
/infra/deploy @taylor-nguyen
```
Taylor Nguyen: I authored the deploy bits originally, happy to approve once CI is green. Seeing lint failure now.
Alex Kim: Clarifying Q: if one owner approves both hunks (same person), is that allowed, or do we need distinct owners per path?
Priya Desai: Policy we've followed: at least one approver from each OWNER entry that matches changed files. If both paths map to the same owner or team, one person is fine. If different teams, get one from each.
Jordan Lee: Right. For small/noop infra tweaks we sometimes do an exception (owner-exception label + manager signoff) to avoid blocking on timing.
Alex Kim: This is a tiny change (two params) but fixes OOM. Can we use an exception? Priya — can you sign off as manager if Taylor can't get to it?
Priya Desai: I can do manager signoff, but prefer Taylor ack for infra. Taylor?
Taylor Nguyen: I can look now. If it's just whitespace + a single param change I'll approve. If tests are failing unrelated, don't block on me.
CODEOWNERS-bot: Matched owners for PR #3421: /runtime/cache -> Jordan Lee; /infra/deploy -> Taylor Nguyen.
ci-bot: PR #3421 — unit-tests failed: test_cache_eviction.py:42
Alex Kim: I'll push a lint fix and re-run CI in ~8m. tagging for visibility :eyes:
ci-bot: Re-run requested by Alex Kim — job queued.
ci-bot: PR #3421 — all checks passed ✅
Jordan Lee: LGTM from runtime side, approving. :thumbsup:
Taylor Nguyen: Reviewed infra portion, looks safe. Approving now to unblock.
Priya Desai: Approving as manager to allow exception and unblock. Please follow up with a postmortem if rollout has impact.
Alex Kim: Merged and deployed. Thanks all :shipit:
Alex Kim: Filed follow-up ticket to split hotfixs from feature work: #358. Also opening a small PR to propose consolidating CODEOWNERS for shared runtime/infra paths to @platform-team so cross-area hotfixes route to one team.
Priya Desai: Nice. Let's keep the consolidation PR lightweight — won't change approvals, just mapping so these quick fixes are less noisy.
Jordan Lee: Sounds good. If you want, I can review the CODEOWNERS consolidation PR tomorrow.
Taylor Nguyen: I'll +1 once CI stable
